summary.purpose: Verify that a new task can be added successfully
summary.expected: Task is added and displayed in the task list

summary.purpose: Verify that a task can be marked as completed
summary.expected: Task is marked as completed and displayed as such in the task list

summary.purpose: Verify that a task can be deleted successfully
summary.expected: Task is deleted and no longer displayed in the task list

test_cases.steps: 1. Enter task title 2. Enter task description (optional) 3. Click Add Task 4. Verify task is added to the task list
1. Find a task in the task list 2. Click the Complete button 3. Verify task is marked as completed
1. Find a task in the task list 2. Click the Delete button 3. Verify task is deleted from the task list
